chapter: National Guard band and first jobs in Chicago
title: Playing jazz gigs in East Chicago, Indiana
summary: His first work was a small group playing night gigs and holidays in East Chicago, riding the Illinois Central and passing the hat.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, was that job with Young's band then your first professional job, or had you worked with anybody before that?

I'd worked with -- well, this little group out -- just out of Chicago called Indiana, which is still part of the city of Chicago, but East Chicago, and that is going into like East Chicago. You know, that's where a lot of the -- lot of baseball players came out of, and some athletes like prize fighters. It's on the outskirts.
Oh, it is part of Chicago.

Yeah. (Unintelligible) played night gigs, holidays, four, five of us, we'd go out there on the Illinois Central train, just a suburban train, about 40 minutes ride, and we'd play the job. We'd play on the train probably coming back. We'd pass the hat. We didn't mind.
Well, what sort of -- now, what time are we talking of now?
This was in -- this was around in '22 and '20 -- '22 and '23.
Well, were you playing jazz then?
Yeah, strictly jazz, trumpet, trombone, clarinet. I was thinking of clarinet playing.
